title: Make dashboard timestamp sorts offset-aware
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: GET /api/tasks (src/dashboard/server.ts:178-186) sorts by `created_at` and GET /api/claims (src/dashboard/server.ts:501) by `claimed_at` using `.localeCompare` on raw timestamp strings, which mis-orders records across differing timezone offsets (same class as task-ranking-offset-aware). Replace with offset-aware comparison (reuse `byCreatedAtThenId`-style parsing or the shared comparator where applicable).
acceptance: `/api/tasks` sort=created_at and `/api/claims` sort by `claimed_at` order by real instant for records with differing timezone offsets.
Title/priority/id sorts and asc/desc behavior are unchanged.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
